metadata.title: Karp Says AI Labs May Need Nationalizing to Escape Lawsuits

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR) CEO Alex Karp told CNBC that leading AI labs may need to be nationalized, because without it his clients would sue them over the technology's unlimited risks. On regulation he was blunt. "You have to find a way to set reasonable guidelines that are enforced, but you can't do it," he said.
Karp said the first line of defense is that builders are liable for their own actions, and made the case for both civil and criminal penalties for developers who are not being responsible. "We need to get serious," he said of the capabilities of the latest models.
The industry is split. Anthropic's Dario Amodei called for a slowdown last weekend, joined by Sam Altman and Elon Musk. Trump has called AI risks a hoax, with Nvidia Corp. (NASDAQ:NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang and Meta Platforms Inc. (NASDAQ:META) CEO Mark Zuckerberg on that side. OpenAI disclosed six new cases of unexpected or concerning model behavior on Wednesday, on top of the Hugging Face breach.
